en.title: Google Pixel 7a Case - Durable Silicone Android Phone Case - Charcoal
bullets: The Pixel 7a Case protects your phone while adding a touch of fresh color and sophisticated style
It’s designed specifically for Pixel 7a, with durable, stain-resistant material and raised edges to protect your phone in all those “oops” moments
Made from soft-to-the-touch silicone and over 35% recycled plastics, the case delivers a great balance of comfort and durability[1]
It comes in a variety of colors, with subtle metallic accents for a pop of style
Please refer to the product description section below for all applicable legal disclaimers denoted by the bracketed numbers in the preceding bullet points (e.g., [1], [2], etc.)
en.description: The Pixel 7a Case protects your phone while adding a touch of fresh color and sophisticated style. Made from soft silicone, it’s a great balance of comfort and durability. And the metallic logo and side buttons add a pop of style. LEGAL [1]Based on product weight.
